'''Mox Freedan''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Freedan was a member of [[Wolf Clan]]<ref name="TCSWE" />&mdash;one of several [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi clans]] that young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were placed in when they commenced their Jedi training<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]&mdash;alongside fellow members [[Kiri]], [[Lina Lascol]], [[Lartan]], and [[Ezak]]. Together, the clan lived and learnt about [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mox Freedan was mentioned in the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
